recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核分成 6 個緊密排列的小葉、染色質濃縮，細胞大小正常；此圖與同系列 65651 看起來是同一視野，辨識重點同樣是單顆細胞 ≥6 葉。
features: Single neutrophil with six closely clustered nuclear lobes
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules; no obvious toxic changes
Normal-sized cell relative to surrounding red cells
Background red cells mostly normocytic with occasional poikilocytes; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with six closely clustered nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin, in a cell of normal size with finely granular cytoplasm. No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, or vacuoles are evident. Red cells are largely normocytic with occasional poikilocytes, and platelets are present. This field appears identical to image 65651 of the same series. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia requires supporting macro-ovalocytes, raised MCV, and low B12 or folate beyond a single hypersegmented neutrophil.
The benign inherited trait is separated by normal vitamin studies and a family history.
Giant neutrophils are about twice normal size, whereas this cell is normal-sized.
